note: Workbook demonstration data, not a live ERP position. On-hand in the source workbook is pseudo-random in the SKU id, so treat stock levels as illustrative.

formulas.f01-ads-per-store: base_ads * seasonality * arch_horizon_factor * store_size * (1 + demand_lever / 100) * IF(AND(promo_eligible = "Y", promo_lever > 0), 1 + (promo_lever / 100) * 1.3 * (1 - promo_depth), 1)
formulas.f05-rop: ROUND(ads * (MAX(1, lead_time_days + lead_time_adjust) + MAX(0, safety_days + safety_adjust)))
formulas.f06-maximum-inventory: ROUND(ads * (MAX(1, lead_time_days + lead_time_adjust) + MAX(0, safety_days + safety_adjust) + horizon_coverage))
formulas.f07-inventory-state: IF(position < rop * 0.6, "Stockout", IF(position < rop, "Low", IF(AND(perishable = "Y", days_of_supply > shelf_life_days), "Expiry", IF(AND(perishable = "N", days_of_supply > 15), "Overstock", IF(AND(velocity < 1, days_of_supply > 10), "Slow-mover", "Healthy")))))
formulas.f23-markdown-at-risk-gross: IF(state = "Expiry", MAX(0, position - ads * shelf_life_days) * price, IF(OR(state = "Overstock", state = "Slow-mover"), IF(MAX(0, position - max_inventory) > 0, (position - max_inventory) * price, position * 0.3 * price), 0))
